task.description:
Review the Step 2a implementation (commit 9ac7c2eb on branch feature/WF02-batch-4-20260811) against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. This batch touches: (1) src/db/partition_conversion.zig -- PAR-05 online partition conversion, a schema/DDL-adjacent operation on the events table; (2) migrations/1150_par06_instance_projections_event_window.sql -- PAR-06 window-column migration plus Store.append()/reconstructBounded() changes; (3) src/engine/pin_resolver.zig -- PIN-01 AC3/AC4/AC5, resolves variable_schema and applies pin_overrides, returns UnresolvedCatalogRef/UnresolvedModuleRef for the explicitly out-of-scope AC1/AC2 branches; (4) migrations/1151_pin02_instance_started_pinned_versions.sql and the src/engine/instance.zig InstanceStore.create() call site -- PIN-02, pin set now recorded in the INSTANCE_STARTED event payload. Determine independently whether any of this is a tenant-data path (new/changed API route, migration, Lua/Wasm host function, secrets code, or response-shaping/lookup-by-ID code) requiring full review against the numbered security invariants, or whether it is out of scope for a PASS-with-note. Do not assume the answer -- this is your determination to make, not ORCH's. Pay particular attention to: tenant isolation in the partition-conversion backfill/swap path (PAR-05), whether the new window columns/migration in PAR-06 could leak cross-tenant data through reconstruction, and whether PIN-01/PIN-02's variable_schema and pin_overrides resolution paths enforce tenant scoping when looking up catalog/schema entries by reference.

REWORK 1 RE-REVIEW: BACKEND-DEV fixed the INV-1 finding in commit 23eff3b2. pin_resolver.zig's
resolveServiceCatalogRef() now binds tenant_id as a parameterized $2::uuid against
service_catalog.owner_tenant_id (threaded via ResolutionInput.tenant_id, sourced in instance.zig
from the existing threadlocal tenant_context populated by auth middleware), replacing the dropped
bpm_effective_tenant_id() SQL function reference entirely. New regression test
tests/integration/pin01_service_catalog_tenant_scope_test.zig (3 cases: cross-tenant denial via
UnresolvedCatalogRef, same-tenant success, global-scope success) verified passing 3/3 against real
Postgres via the new test-integration-pin01 build step. Please re-review specifically:
1. Confirm the ::uuid binding in resolveServiceCatalogRef() (pin_resolver.zig, near line 197) is
   correctly parameterized (no string interpolation) and correctly scopes by owner_tenant_id.
2. Confirm tenant_id in instance.zig is sourced from a trustworthy request-scoped context (not
   client-supplied, not guessable) -- verify tenant_context.get() is populated only by auth
   middleware from the validated JWT/session, not from any request body/query param.
3. Confirm the regression test genuinely proves cross-tenant denial (not just a same-tenant happy
   path) by reading tests/integration/pin01_service_catalog_tenant_scope_test.zig directly.
4. PAR-05 and PAR-06 do not need re-review -- unchanged since your original PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit determination of tenant-data-path status for each of the 4 changed files/areas
Full review against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md for any area determined in-scope
PASS with one-line note for any area determined out-of-scope, with the reasoning stated
Any invariant violation found is a FAIL with specific invariant number and file:line cited, not a vague concern
Any NEW incidental security-adjacent finding is filed as its own ISS + GitHub issue per core-directives.md, not silently noted only in this handoff

result.summary: REWORK 1 RE-REVIEW PASS. Verified commit 23eff3b2 correctly fixes the prior INV-1 BLOCKER in pin_resolver.zig's resolveServiceCatalogRef(). (1) SQL now reads 'WHERE service_id = $1 AND (scope = 'global' OR owner_tenant_id = $2::uuid)' with tenant_id bound via uuidToHex()+parameterized $2 -- no string interpolation, no reference to the dropped bpm_effective_tenant_id() function anywhere in pin_resolver.zig or instance.zig (grep across src/ and tests/ confirms the function is still referenced elsewhere in unrelated pre-existing LEGACY_RLS code paths not in scope for this fix, per iss503_rls_removal.md's phased cutover). Mirrors the existing service_catalog.zig getServiceForTenant() pattern. INV-7 satisfied. (2) Traced instance.zig InstanceStore.create(): request_tenant_id = parseUuid(tenant_context.get()). tenant_context.zig is threadlocal storage; its only set() callers in the entire src/ tree (excluding tests) are the 5 call sites in src/api/middleware/auth.zig, all downstream of Bearer-token verification -- either principal.tenant_id from verifyBearerTokenWithIssuer()'s validated JWT claims, or resolveTenantContext(raw_token) which decodes the tenant_id claim directly out of the JWT payload segment of the Authorization header token (base64-decoded, JSON-parsed, UUID-format-validated against canonical re-serialization). No call site reads from a request body field or query parameter. INV-1/INV-2 satisfied -- context is trustworthy and not client-spoofable via body/query. (3) Read tests/integration/pin01_service_catalog_tenant_scope_test.zig in full (361 lines, 3 tests). TC-PIN01-RW1-01 creates two distinct real fixture tenants (owner B, caller A), inserts a scope='tenant' service_catalog row owned by B, then calls PinResolver.resolve() with A's tenant_id and asserts ResolutionError.UnresolvedCatalogRef -- a genuine cross-tenant negative-path assertion, not a happy-path test. TC-02 (same-tenant success) and TC-03 (global-scope success for a tenant not even in the fixture DB) serve as controls proving the mechanism isn't just universally failing/passing. INV-6 satisfied. Ran 'zig build test-integration-pin01' once (after confirming no concurrent zig process via Get-Process, waiting out two transient background zig processes first) -- exit 0, clean pass, consistent with the commit's claimed 3/3. Also re-ran tools/lint_sql_param_types.py, lint_migration_schema.py, lint_sql_table_refs.py -- all exit 0 clean. PAR-05/PAR-06 not re-reviewed per task instruction (confirmed via git diff 9ac7c2eb..23eff3b2 --stat that neither src/db/partition_conversion.zig nor migrations/1150_par06_instance_projections_event_window.sql are touched by this rework commit) -- original PASS stands unchanged.
